mathematical_contract.factorization: Hypersolve divides both authored bivariate equations exactly by the certified rational component and retains both cofactor equations; multiplication by the published component reconstructs each authored equation exactly
partition_events: authored retained endpoints zero and one
mathematical_contract.branch_domains: every open cell is classified by an exact rational sample, exact derivative sign, and exact lifted range; adjacent cells merge only when orientation agrees and no pole separates them
mathematical_contract.overlap_orientation: retained and lifted ranges are transported into canonical analytic-parallel-first order with explicit same or reversed orientation
mathematical_contract.isolated_points: uncovered finite authored endpoints or zero/unit lifted-image boundaries are replayed as exact parameter pairs and may coexist with overlap branches
mathematical_contract.residuals: the divided cofactor system remains authoritative for all isolated intersections not lying on the extracted component
mathematical_contract.fast_disjointness: a residual equation is declared rootless only when exact tensor-product Bernstein conversion over [0,1]^2 gives every control coefficient one common strict sign; mixed, zero, or undecidable controls fall through to complete resultants
mathematical_contract.selected_parallel: each overlap domain and isolated component pair independently replays the signed selected-normal branch; negative branch evidence is discarded and a vanishing branch is rejected
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT accepts only exact division, root isolation, ordering, rational images, Bernstein signs, branch signs, and parameter equality
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 uses the same construction and may terminate only where the inherited Hyperreal policy permits the 512-bit equality decision; it does not construct approximate parameters, components, contacts, or ranges
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: unsupported coefficient towers, additional positive-dimensional residual components, and unresolved higher-nullity systems retain explicit incomplete candidate evidence

implementation.result_shape: BezierParallelIntersectionSet2 stores Arc<[contact]>, Arc<[overlap]>, and Option<Arc<candidates>> so complete contacts and overlaps are not mutually exclusive and successful results do not retain full projection vectors
implementation.component_shape: RationalParameterComponentSystem2 transports overlap slices, isolated parameter-pair slices, and the two exactly divided residual equations
implementation.partition: rational_parameter_component_domains sorts and exact-deduplicates every pole, stationary, zero-image, unit-image, and authored-endpoint boundary before cell classification
implementation.residual_projection: parallel_candidate_system_from_rational_component first attempts the exact Bernstein unit-square exclusion and otherwise sends the cofactors through the existing complete projection, axis-saturation, and replay spine
implementation.cached_candidates: candidate-only calls reuse a cached certified rational PH projection even when it reports the permitted DegenerateResultant marker
implementation.cached_overlaps: full intersection calls accept an early rational overlap only when the rational authority certifies one overlap; noninjective or mixed components remain degenerate there and continue into multi-branch component partition
implementation.regression_guard: the noninjective public test performs a candidate query first, then proves that the same cached object still returns both oriented overlap branches under both policies

matched_release_benchmark.method: five sequential all-feature release-binary processes per revision pinned to CPU 11 with identical fixtures and iterations; visible whole-process contention samples are retained and medians are reported
matched_release_benchmark.historical_semantics: the extracted overlap is complete, but both divided residual equations are sent through generic degree-32 projections even when one is sign-definite over the authored square; simple cached overlaps also rebuild generic bivariate systems
matched_release_benchmark.candidate_semantics: the same overlap is returned with residual disjointness exactly certified; residual systems with actual isolated roots continue through complete resultants

warm_ph_overlap_candidates.interpretation: ten-iteration sub-four-microsecond sentinel; direction is authoritative but fine-grained magnitude is noisy

ordinary_sentinels.interpretation: ordinary exact and higher-nullity medians remain within 1.57 percent of the immediate parent while the new fast paths are restricted to certified component residuals and cached rational parallels

matched_heaptrack.method: identical complete release benchmark processes pinned to CPU 11 under Heaptrack record-only; heaptrack_print summaries are authoritative
